title: Scan a code
description: Point the camera at the QR code or barcode, or type the number.

idle.title: Camera is off
idle.body: You can type the code below.

insecure.title: The camera needs a secure connection
insecure.body: Open the site at an address that starts with https:// and the camera will work. Until then, type the code below.

no_camera.title: No camera found
no_camera.body: This device has no camera the browser can use. Type the code below.

asking.title: Allow the camera
asking.body: The browser is asking for permission to use the camera. Press Allow.

denied.title: The camera is not allowed
denied.body: Press the padlock or the settings icon in the address bar, allow the camera for this site, then try again. You can also type the code below.

busy.title: The camera is in use
busy.body: Another app or tab holds the camera. Close it and try again, or type the code below.

failed.title: The camera did not start
failed.body: Try again, or type the code below.

searching.title: Looking for a code
searching.body: Hold the code inside the frame. In poor light, turn the phone's light on.

manual.label: Type it instead
manual.placeholder: Number on the tag or pack
manual.invalid: Type a code of up to {{max}} characters.

animal.title: Scan the animal's tag
animal.hint: Hold the tag's QR code or barcode inside the frame.
animal.noneBody: No animal on this farm carries this code. Check the tag, or look the animal up by its number.
animal.severalBody: More than one animal carries this code. Choose the one in front of you.
animal.offFarm: {{tag}} is no longer on the farm.

item.title: Scan the item
item.hint: Hold the barcode on the pack, or the printed label, inside the frame.
item.noneBody: No item in the warehouse list carries this code. Choose the item from the list, and save the barcode on the item so the next scan finds it.
item.severalBody: More than one item carries this code. Choose the right one.
item.inactive: {{name}} is switched off in the item list.
item.barcodeHint: Scan the pack or type the number
item.barcodeTitle: Scan the barcode on the pack

tags.title: Tags with QR codes
tags.description: Choose a herd and print a tag for every animal in it. The code holds the animal's number and nothing else.
tags.chosen: Tags for the animals chosen in the list: {{n}}.
tags.pickBody: The tags of every animal now in the herd will be laid out for printing. To print only some, tick them in the animal list.
tags.emptyBody: There is no animal in this herd now.

itemLabels.title: Item labels with QR codes
itemLabels.description: Stick a label on the shelf or the sack and scan it when receiving or issuing. The code holds the item's barcode or its own code, never a price.
itemLabels.emptyBody: There is no item in this category.
itemLabels.more: {{shown}} of {{total}} items are shown. Choose a category to print the rest.

scale.title: Weights from a scale file
scale.description: Choose the file the electronic scale saved. You will see which animal every line means before anything is recorded.
scale.formats: A CSV or text file: one line per animal, with the tag or electronic number and the weight in kilograms.

file.tooBig: This file is larger than 2 MB. A scale file is much smaller: check that you chose the right one.
file.notText: This is a spreadsheet file. In the spreadsheet choose Save as, then CSV, and pick that file.
file.unreadable: The file could not be read. Try choosing it again.
file.empty: The file has no lines with data.

scale.headerRow: The first row holds the column names
scale.pickColumns: Choose which column holds the tag and which holds the weight.
scale.tooMany: The file has {{rows}} lines. At most {{max}} can be recorded at a time: split the file in two.

unit.lb: The weights in this file are in pounds. Set the scale to kilograms and save the file again.
unit.g: The weights in this file are in grams. Set the scale to kilograms and save the file again.

scale.none: No line of this file can be recorded.

status.unmatched: No animal on the farm carries this number.
status.several: Several animals carry this number: {{tags}}. Weigh this one by hand.
status.not_on_farm: {{tag}} is no longer on the farm.
status.implausible: Heavier than this species can be: the most is {{max}} kg.
status.before_birth: The weighing date is before this animal was born.
status.duplicate: The same animal comes again on line {{line}}: the later weight is taken.

problem.no_code: The line has no tag or electronic number.
problem.code_damaged: A spreadsheet turned the electronic number into a rounded figure and its digits are lost. Save the file from the scale again without opening it in a spreadsheet.
problem.not_a_number: The weight is not a number.
problem.ambiguous: The weight can be read two ways, as about a kilogram or as over a tonne. Enter this one by hand.
problem.unit: The weight is not in kilograms.
problem.not_positive: The weight is zero or below: there was no animal on the scale.

errors.SCAN_UNREADABLE: This code cannot be read as a tag or item number. Scan it again or type the number.
errors.WEIGHT_NOT_PLAUSIBLE: Check the weight: it is more than this species can weigh
